title: LEGS AND BALANCE
subtitle: MONDAY LEGS. SEATED FIRST, THEN STANDING AT THE CHAIR. NO FLOOR TODAY. KIND HIPS.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Monday is legs and balance, about eleven minutes. We start in the chair with a gentle march, a light figure four, and a few easy sit to stands, then we stay standing at the chair for a kind hip flexor stretch and two rounds of balance. No floor today. A smaller range is fine on sore-joint days. Well done for showing up to start the week.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, shoulders soft, slow easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush at all.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. Legs and balance done, hips looked after, and a lovely start to the week. Have a sip of water and enjoy your Monday. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED GENTLE MARCH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, hands resting on the thighs or the seat edge. March slowly in place, lifting one knee a few inches, then the other. Soft shoulders, slow breath. Small lifts are plenty. If the front of the left hip pinches, lift the left knee only a little, or just raise the left heel instead. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated gentle march. Two easy bursts of about twenty seconds. Sit tall, lift one knee a few inches, then the other, nice and slow. Keep the left lift small if the hip grumbles.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet flat. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: March done. Legs are awake. Lovely start.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat. Rest the right ankle over the left thigh, just above the knee. Stay tall and tip forward from the hips only a touch, until you feel a mild stretch in the outer hip or buttock. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch sides. Keep it light: never press the knee down or fold deep. If the left groin or front of the hip pinches on that side, skip it or simply rest the ankle without leaning. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. About fifteen seconds each side, twice through. Rest one ankle over the other thigh, sit tall, and tip forward just a touch. Never forced.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Both feet on the floor. Soften.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. Hips feeling looked after.

exercises.name: EASY SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of the sturdy chair, feet flat and a little apart, slightly behind the knees. Lean forward a little, nose over toes, and press through the whole foot to stand up tall. Then sit back down slowly and softly, reaching back with the bottom. Use your hands on the thighs or the chair arms as much as you like. Five calm reps is plenty; three is fine on sore-knee or sore-hip days. Keep it smooth, no dropping into the seat. Stop if you feel sharp groin, hip, or knee pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness. On the last rep, stay standing.
exercises.speakStart: Easy sit to stand. Two rounds of five. Feet back a little, lean forward, press through the feet and stand tall, then sit down slow and soft. Use your hands as much as you like. Three is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Sit and breathe. You're doing grand.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stand done. That's real leg work, Pam. Stay standing now, and come to the chair back for the rest.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with one hand lightly on the chair back. Step one foot back about half a step, not a deep lunge, both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under, belt buckle toward the ribs, until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the back hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds, then swap legs. Start with the left leg back and keep that side extra gentle. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing hip flexor. About twenty seconds each leg, twice through. Hand on the chair, small step back, tuck the pelvis, tiny lean. Left leg first, extra gentle.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Hip flexor stretch done. A lovely undo for all the sitting.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand behind or beside the sturdy chair with one or both hands on the chair back. Stand tall, tummy gently in. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot just an inch, for about fifteen seconds, then switch sides. Eyes on a fixed point ahead, breathe. Hold the chair as firmly as you need. If the left hip grumbles when standing on it, keep the toes of the other foot lightly touching the floor. Stop if anything feels sharp or worryingly wobbly.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. About fifteen seconds each side, two rounds. Hands on the chair, stand tall, lift one foot a little, eyes ahead. Hold on as much as you like.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Legs and balance all looked after. Have a grand Monday.
